job.title: Senior Platform Engineer
job.pay_full: $96,000 – $163,000 a year base salary (O'Fallon, Missouri); may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role

details.about: Mastercard powers digital payments in more than 200 countries and territories. This hands-on role on the Big Data Engineering team designs, runs and keeps improving highly available, secure and scalable platform infrastructure for enterprise applications and distributed data environments, working closely with application, development, infrastructure and security teams.
duties: Design, build, operate and maintain scalable, secure, resilient and cost-efficient cloud and platform infrastructure
Support and improve highly available Big Data and distributed computing environments
Deploy, administer, troubleshoot and optimize Kubernetes and other container platforms
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that automate integration, testing, security validation and deployment
Automate infrastructure with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible
Write software, scripts and automation in Java, Python or similar languages
Administer and troubleshoot Linux/Unix systems and monitor platform health, capacity and performance
Implement security controls in line with Mastercard's security, change-management and regulatory standards
Take part in operational support, incident resolution and root-cause analysis, and share knowledge with teammates
needs: Hands-on experience designing, building, operating or supporting enterprise cloud and platform infrastructure
Experience operating highly available, mission-critical distributed systems
Proficiency with Kubernetes, containers and container orchestration
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment
Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform, Ansible or similar
Strong Linux/Unix administration and troubleshooting, including shell scripting
Proficiency in at least one language such as Java or Python
Understanding of microservices, enterprise networking and distributed-system concepts
Ability to implement infrastructure security controls and troubleshoot complex problems across the stack
Strong written and verbal communication skills
nice: Hadoop or other distributed data processing platforms
Operating or modernizing large-scale Big Data environments
Migrating workloads to cloud-native or modern platforms
Supporting large ETL or data-processing pipelines
SQL, data warehousing or massively parallel processing
Understanding of statistics, machine learning or data-intensive workloads
details.benefits: Base salary $96,000 – $163,000 a year in O'Fallon, Missouri; may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. Benefits for full-time employees generally include medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability and life insurance; flexible spending and health savings accounts; 16 weeks of new parent leave; 80 hours of paid sick and safe time, 25 days of vacation and 5 personal days (pro-rated by hire date); 10 paid U.S. holidays; a 401(k) with company match; fitness reimbursement or on-site fitness facilities; and eligibility for tuition reimbursement.
notes: Mastercard intends to fill this position by 02/10/2027

yt_title: Mastercard Is Hiring: Senior Platform Engineer | O'Fallon, MO | $96K–$163K

scenes.head: Today's job
lines: Welcome to Veritas Recruitment Agency, where we bring you real tech jobs straight from employers' own careers sites.
Today, Mastercard is hiring a Senior Platform Engineer for its Big Data Engineering team in O'Fallon, Missouri.
You'll find the direct application link in the description.

scenes.head: About Mastercard
lines: Mastercard powers digital payments in more than two hundred countries and territories.
In this hands-on role, you'll keep the platforms behind its big data and enterprise applications available, secure, and fast, working closely with application, infrastructure, and security teams.
show: Mastercard powers digital payments in more than 200 countries and territories.

scenes.head: What you'll do
bullets: Build & run cloud and platform infrastructure
lines: You'll design, build, and run cloud and platform infrastructure for mission-critical systems.
You'll operate Kubernetes and container platforms, build C I C D pipelines, and automate infrastructure with tools like Terraform and Ansible.
You'll write automation in Java or Python, look after Linux systems, put security controls in place, and help resolve incidents and find their root causes.
show: You'll operate Kubernetes and container platforms, build CI/CD pipelines, and automate infrastructure with tools like Terraform and Ansible.

scenes.head: What you need
lines: You'll need hands-on experience with enterprise cloud and platform infrastructure, and with running highly available distributed systems.
You should be proficient with Kubernetes and containers, C I C D pipelines, and infrastructure as code, with strong Linux skills and shell scripting.
You'll also need at least one language such as Java or Python, and a good grasp of microservices, networking, and infrastructure security.
Experience with Hadoop or other big data platforms is a plus.
show: You should be proficient with Kubernetes and containers, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code, with strong Linux skills and shell scripting.

scenes.head: Pay & benefits
lines: The base salary in O'Fallon is ninety-six thousand to one hundred sixty-three thousand dollars a year, and the role may be eligible for an annual bonus.

Benefits generally include medical, dental, and vision insurance, twenty-five vacation days plus five personal days, ten paid holidays, sixteen weeks of new parent leave, a four-oh-one-k with a company match, and tuition reimbursement.
